strings:
Written for Noctiluca's corpus, reduced from Hacker News's front page:
     a table laying the page out, holding the stories' table. Each story is
     a row (its rank right-aligned in a narrow cell, an empty vote cell, the
     title) and a row of subtext; from rank 10 the rank is wider. Its style
     is the site's own: Verdana 10pt in an 85% wide table.
A glow survey of the north bay
A diver's guide to sea sparkle
A history of the old pier
